rules: A UI button, a menu entry, a dialog filter or a route table is upstream-has evidence only. It is never a proven result.
webProven and desktopProven start at 'chưa thử' for every row and may only change when the evidence register names a command, artifact, environment and fixture.
mustPort is true only for rows inside the Q1-B pilot scope. OCR and AI assistance are tagged and excluded from M1.
Every mustPort row must name at least one fixture id that exists in fixtures/manifest.json with an expected result.

coverageRule: A row is claimed when mustPort is true. Every claimed row must list at least one fixture id present in fixtures/manifest.json, and every such fixture must declare an expected result and list this capability id back in its capabilities array. verify-manifest.mjs fails when either direction is missing.
knownGaps: webProven and desktopProven are 'chưa thử' for every row: no editor was executed. Separate upstream test and build baselines exist outside this lane and are prerequisites, not editor evidence.
macOS and Safari are deferred (QA-01, UNI-671).

The AI-assisted authoring surfaces (packages/pipelines, packages/agent-core, packages/ai-provider, packages/ai-search) are inventoried only where a task-3 row needs them; a full AI capability matrix is not an M1 requirement.
packages/ai-search depends on the closed @genspark/cli; its licence and provenance are unresolved and are handed to task 4.
